text: Years passed. Musa grew into a strong young man, and Allah gave him wisdom and knowledge.
One day he entered the city, and found two men fighting. One from his own people, and one from his enemy.
The man from his people called to him for help. Musa struck the other man once... and the man died.
He had never meant to kill him. He said: "This is from the work of Satan."
And he turned to his Lord at once: "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me." And Allah forgave him.
But the news spread. And a man came running from the far end of the city: "O Musa, the chiefs are planning to kill you. Leave!"
So he left Egypt alone, afraid, looking over his shoulder. And he prayed: "My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people."
